sections.title: All in one suite
sections.description: Mail, Calendar, Contacts and To Do now live in a single native Windows app. Move between them without leaving Wino, and keep every account — Outlook, Gmail, IMAP/SMTP and CalDAV — in one place.

sections.title: Wino Intelligence
sections.description: Summaries, smart replies and search that understands what you mean. Available with monthly subscription.

sections.title: Faster and more secure
sections.description: A rebuilt, natively compiled core brings quicker start-up, lower memory use and snappier folder switching. S/MIME signing and encryption keep your mail private.

sections.title: Wino Companion
sections.description: A small flyout that opens from the Wino icon in the Windows system tray, or from a global keyboard shortcut. Your next events, unread messages, My Day tasks and favorite contacts — without opening the main window.
